verdict.rationale: LocalAI is built to be self-hosted. The docs give a one-line Docker run command, describe a single binary serving an OpenAI-compatible API at localhost:8080, and state that no GPU is required and that a CPU path is tested in CI. They also document self-hosted extras such as distributed worker nodes and multi-user auth. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of real-world self-hosting beyond vendor docs and the project's own repo.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: One binary with an OpenAI-compatible API in front of it.
Every feature ships a CPU path first. That path is tested in CI, on the hardware most people already have
Distributed nodes: Add GPU worker nodes that self-register with a frontend coordinator
